name: Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on Iraq, notably the situation of women’s rights and the recent proposal to amend the Personal Status Law
part_text:
The European Parliament is asking Iraq's Parliament to reject proposed changes to the country's Personal Status Law. These changes would move family matters like marriage, divorce and child custody from civil courts to religious courts. For some, the minimum age for marriage would drop to 9 for girls and 15 for boys. The Parliament says this would break Iraq's international commitments on women's rights. It also calls on the European Union and its member states to speak out against the changes and to link development aid to better training and support for women.

- The changes would move family law to religious courts; they affect Iraqi women and girls.
- The Parliament asks Iraq to reject the changes and protect women's rights.
- The EU is urged to condemn the changes and tie aid to women's protection.
